correctness.rationale: The exact convolution identity is verified coefficientwise. The eigenvector equation gives w_{i+1}+w_{i-1}=(theta+theta^{-1}-epsilon_i)w_i with epsilon_i=(1-theta)^2/(theta varrho mu_i). Since alpha>1, epsilon is summable. The backward Volterra construction gives a decaying solution asymptotic to theta^i; reduction of order gives an independent theta^{-i} branch, which is incompatible with w=P phi in ell_1. Therefore phi_i=w_i/(varrho mu_i) has the stated positive-tail asymptotic. Symmetry and simplicity give the negative-tail asymptotic. The omitted-mass and exponential-moment conclusions follow from geometric comparison.
